##### Project general facts

Samana Ibiza is a vibrant residential development located in the dynamic and bustling community, where every day becomes a joyful journey and life turns into a never-ending celebration. Designed for those who seek something extraordinary from each moment, this well-curated fusion of contemporary comfort and conventional charm features studios and one and two-bedroom apartments with private pools. The development offers a seamless blend of elegance and excitement, with every detail crafted to enhance a lifestyle of relaxation and vibrancy.

Life at Samana Ibiza pulses with energy and excitement, offering a journey towards vibrance. Residents enjoy private pools for intimate escapes, main pools perfect for lively gatherings, and world-class amenities designed to bring the spirit of Ibiza right to the doorstep. A state-of-the-art fitness center inspires and empowers, while thoughtfully curated spaces blend elegance with ease, creating a lifestyle of effortless luxury and tranquility.

Every residence at Samana Ibiza features thoughtfully curated spaces with premium finishes, modern aesthetics, and meticulous attention to detail. Open layouts invite natural light, while luxurious materials exude sophistication. Soft, neutral tones and luxurious textures enhance relaxation and togetherness, creating an inviting sanctuary of comfort and style. Kitchens are fully equipped, and smart living concepts offer effortless comfort with lighting and climate settings at the touch of a button.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in the heart of a swiftly growing district set to become Dubai's next vibrant hub, this exceptional location offers an ideal lifestyle for residents. Strategically positioned between Emirates and Al Ain Highways, the community provides easy connectivity to a wide range of places within the city and beyond, including Global Village, Dubai Outlet Mall, IMG World, Dubai Airport, Dubai Mall, Miracle Garden, Downtown Dubai, and Burj Khalifa.

The location is distinguished by its thoughtful planning and comprehensive amenities. A private family club and community center are filled with amenities for everyone to enjoy, while schools, medical facilities, and a variety of retail options ensure all essentials are within easy reach, creating a seamless living experience for all.

For those seeking a residence that embodies vibrant energy, modern convenience, and a prime Dubai address, DLRC delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of strategic connectivity, world-class amenities, and a prestigious location makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can live with flair — vibrant, connected and effortlessly refined.
